## Purpose

Write identity and sampling configuration to a compatible ResearchOS BLE sensor node and register it locally.

## Capability IDs

- `sensor_node_provisioner`

## Requirements

- Compatible ResearchOS BLE sensor firmware.
- Bluetooth permissions.
